course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Build a short opinion with a clear claim and reason about media habits.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing everyday media choices such as news apps, podcasts, social media, or TV.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Stating a viewpoint and supporting it with one concrete reason.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about whether it is better to read news briefly every day or only follow longer summaries.

main_focus.name: opinion frame with jag tycker att plus eftersom
main_focus.description: Use jag tycker att or jag anser att with a reason clause to make a compact supported viewpoint.
model_examples: Jag tycker att korta nyheter är praktiska eftersom de sparar tid.
Jag anser att längre sammanfattningar ger bättre sammanhang.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use opinion frames 3-4 times and reason clauses 3-4 times, without turning the dialogue into an essay.

allowed_supporting_grammar: source-framing phrases if a short media item is mentioned
reported content with säger att if natural
modal verbs for habits and preferences

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use media words in an everyday way, focused on habits and reasons rather than politics.

dialogue_shape.opening: A media habit or choice is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They each give a short viewpoint with one reason and compare what works in daily life.
dialogue_shape.ending: They identify one balanced conclusion or personal choice.

target_complexity.repetition: This is the first opinion-building day, so keep the argument short and clear.

focus: the reason supporting the preferred habit
the balanced conclusion or personal choice

sentence_focus: one sentence with jag tycker att
one sentence with eftersom giving a reason
one sentence with sammanfattning or artikel
one sentence stating a personal media habit
